newsitem.title: USA: Michael Foods, North Star set merger date. [CORRECTED 15:10 GMT 14/2]
newsitem.headline: Michael Foods, North Star set merger date. [CORRECTED 15:10 GMT 14/2]

text.p: Michael Foods Inc and North Star Universal Inc said Thursday they have tentatively set February 28 as the closing date for their previously announced merger.

The debt-for-stock deal is still subject to completion of financing arrangements and other conditions, the companies said. The board of North Star also declared a contingent distribution to North Star shareholders of record as of February 27 common stock in a North Star (corrects company name from Michael Foods) spinoff, called ENStar Inc, once the deal closes.
In late 1996, the companies elected to proceed with the merger without a ruling from the Internal Revenue Service on the tax consequences of the deal.
However, the parties will receive a tax opinion letter from their auditors in lieu of an IRS ruling, a Michael Foods spokesman said.
Michael Foods is a food processing company.
Its shares closed down 1/8 Thursday at 12-3/8.
